first_text: 01.Index 02.Projects 03.About Contact (Kolkata, India) A. Backend & AI Engineer Backend engineer first. I design the parts that keep a product standing — service boundaries, queues, caches, rate limits, auth — and I build AI into those systems, not around them. I've shipped a three-service distributed system with a 20 Hz realtime loop, a WebRTC mesh verified against a live server, hybrid multimodal retrieval with cited answers, and LangGraph agents with checkpointed state, durable Postgres queues, circuit-broken model chains and LangSmith evals. Computer Science (IoT, Cybersecurity & Blockchain) at Heritage Institute of Technology, CGPA 9.02. Smart India Hackathon 2025 national finalist.
